    Deck data of a periodic star model #

    From Proposition 4.1 (periodic-mesh-calculations.tex): for a covering π : ℤΔ → Q of a finite quiver by a star model, the deck group is generated by a transformation of height form g (v, t) = (ρ v, t + c₀) with c₀ > 0, and the fibres of π are the g-orbits. We restate this in the form used by the gauge and trace arguments: π ∘ g = π, and two vertices with the same image differ by a power of g or its inverse.

    source
    theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.StarDeck.exists_ne_same_image {t : ℕ} {L : Fin t → ℕ} {V : Type u} [Quiver V] [∀ (x y : V), Subsingleton (x ⟶ y)] {Q : TranslationQuiver V} (hQ : Q.IsStable) (π : (starTree L).ZVert ⥤q V) (hτ : ∀ (Y : (starTree L).ZVert), π.obj ((starTree L).ztau Y) = hQ.tauE (π.obj Y)) [Finite V] :
    ∃ (X : (starTree L).ZVert) (Y : (starTree L).ZVert), X ≠ Y ∧ π.obj X = π.obj Y

    A covering of a finite quiver by ℤΔ identifies two distinct vertices.

    theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.StarDeck.deck_data {t : ℕ} {L : Fin t → ℕ} {V : Type u} [Quiver V] [∀ (x y : V), Subsingleton (x ⟶ y)] {Q : TranslationQuiver V} (hQ : Q.IsStable) (π : (starTree L).ZVert ⥤q V) (hπ : π.IsCovering) (hτ : ∀ (Y : (starTree L).ZVert), π.obj ((starTree L).ztau Y) = hQ.tauE (π.obj Y)) [Finite V] (ht : 0 < t) (hcl : t = 1 ∨ t = 3) :
    ∃ (ρ : StarV L ≃ StarV L) (hρ : ∀ (a b : StarV L), (starTree L).G.Adj (ρ a) (ρ b) ↔ (starTree L).G.Adj a b) (c0 : ℕ) (hρp : ∀ (v : StarV L), (starTree L).par (ρ v) = (starTree L).par v + ↑↑c0), 0 < c0 ∧ (∀ (a b : StarV L), starAdj a b ↔ starAdj (ρ a) (ρ b)) ∧ (∀ (Z : (starTree L).ZVert), π.obj (((starTree L).zAct ρ hρ (↑c0) hρp).obj Z) = π.obj Z) ∧ ∀ (X Y : (starTree L).ZVert), π.obj X = π.obj Y → ∃ (n : ℕ), Y = (StarGauge.gZ ρ hρ c0 hρp)^[n] X ∨ X = (StarGauge.gZ ρ hρ c0 hρp)^[n] Y

    The deck data of a periodic star model (Proposition 4.1(3)).
